purpose: Single source of truth for a dimensionally grounded Allshield Ter Aar FreeCAD/DXF rebuild. Unsupported geometric assumptions are prohibited.

evidence_policy.rule: No geometry may be promoted to model geometry without a named source and evidence status. No regular-grid rounding, mirroring or repetition unless directly supported.

statuses.EXACT_DIMENSION: Direct dimension chain / axis coordinate from source drawing.
statuses.VERIFIED_MULTI_SOURCE: Same interpretation supported by multiple independent supplied sources.
statuses.DEDUCED_FROM_EXACT_DIMENSIONS: Mathematical consequence of exact source dimensions; formula/basis must be stored.
statuses.VECTOR_SOURCE_GEOMETRY: Exact geometry in the supplied vector PDF after calibrated scale transform; accuracy relative to reality is the accuracy of that source plan.
statuses.VISUAL_CONFIRMED: Existence/topology confirmed by photos; dimensions not inferred from appearance.
